ai_review.summary: Boxy audience recording, but a very nice second set makes the show enjoyable
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience source that sounds a bit tinny and boxy, limiting its fidelity. Musically, reviewers highlight a "very nice" second set, indicating strong performance despite the modest audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: One review gives 4 stars and praises the second set while noting only mild recording flaws; weighted estimate yields a solid 4‑star rating but confidence is low due to limited data.
